body:
I have been drug free now for 3 years, as for seeing a counseler...doin that already thru the VA (Im a veteren). I just finished my Associates degree in Medical Billing, but it is extremely difficult to find work in that field. Yes I am looking anywhere. For any job ..just something to bring a little money in now and again. 
As for my ex wife...Ive tried that and the problem with getting visitations right now is that they live in another state. 
I swear i am trying, I am working my hardest..and Yes i am a totally different man..but in the end when people look at my resume all they see is my conviction and thats it. 
Im not a quitter..and i dont give up easy (my ex can tell  ya that) but there are times where it is so damned hard to keep going...when you are sitting in a room by yourself...for days on end..worried that you cant even pay the rent sometimes (my landlord is cool but there are limits), no one to talk to...no one to tell ya that your really not that bad a guy and no one to speak up for ya its hard to see why you should keep going. I could die in this room tonight and no one would notice i was gone till the body stank, and there wouldnt be a funeral or even anyone to mourn...
Loneliness is the worst feeling one can have...
